source: Federal Reserve FOMC meeting calendars (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm and the historical materials by year), scheduled meetings only; 2022 on from council/events.mjs
rule: buy at the close of the M5 candle ending 24 h before the scheduled FOMC statement, exit at the close of the one ending 5 min before it; stop entry - 1.5 x ATR(14) of New York days; long only
